data.name: AlHazl
data.gender_notes: AlHazl is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘ahlah’, meaning 'to rise above, to be exalted or noble'. In Islamic history, Al-Hazl refers to a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his wisdom and piety. The name AlHazl carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlHazl usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes striving for spiritual growth and attaining a noble character.
data.etymology: AlHazl belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlHazl total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: الْحَزْل
in_arabic.long_meaning: الْحَزْل هو مصدر من الحضارة العربية والاسلامية القديمة، يشير الى الاحترام والتقدير والكرامة التي تُمنح لشخص او مقام او مكان، ويرتبط بالتأكيد على القيم الروحية والاخلاقية في الاسلام، ويتضمن概念 الكرامة والاحترام في العلاقات الاجتماعية والدينية

in_urdu.name: الحزل
in_urdu.long_meaning: الحزل ایک عربي اور اسلامی نام ہے جو عظمت، وقار، اور احترام کی علامت ہے، یہ نام روحانی اور اخلاقی اقدار کو نمایاں کرتا ہے، اور اسلام میں معاشرتی اور مذہبی روابط میں عزت اور احترام کے تصور کو شامل کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अल्हज़ल
